name: School Romance: Love or Lose
source:
Your high school life is about to be anything but average—you just got accepted into one of the most prestigious schools in the country! But there’s a catch… In order to stay enrolled, you need to find a girlfriend before the end of the school year!

You’ve never even been on a date—how are you supposed to find a girlfriend?! Fear not, as three of your beautiful classmates seem excited to get to know you. They all have their own ways of showing affection, but which one will grab your heart?
